messages:
jordan (AE): FYI TalusHealth renewal landed on my desk. They want to rebaseline to a 750k tokens/mo commit (up from 500k). Asking for a 15% discount + carryover credits and 90-day price protection. Also asking if we can move them to Dedicated for latency. Need deal-desk + legal + eng input before tomorrow's renewal call.

anita (Sales Eng): We ran a 2-week POC on Dedicated — latency was solid. Perf looks good with q4 quantization profile but I'll re-run with their sequence distribution. Sizing estimate: 2 x A10040GB equiv for steady 750k tokens/mo with headroom. I can provide perf numbers tonight.

kevin (Deal Desk): 15% is higher than our standard uplift band. Typical guideline: increases >20% -> negotiate 8-12%. For a customer of this size and strategic potential we can do 12% + 30-day carryover, or 12% + 60-day carryover if we get a 12-mo commit and a 1.1x ARR uplift target. Also want 90-day price protection is reasonable but needs finance OK. Need modeled numbers (monthly ARR, unit price).

sam (CSM): Talus is high priority — they'll fold more product teams into this if we give predictable pricing. They prefer a 3-year relationship but want a smaller step-up in year 1. We should consider staged discounts or a ramped commit.

marc (Legal): We'll need a DPA + dedicated deployment addendum and a short SOW for data residency. SOC2 attestation is fine; if they require HSM or specific warranty language that adds legal review. No IP transfer asks so far. I can draft redlines once pricing terms are nailed down.

deploy-bot: SOC2 report available (internal link, SSO required): https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025

kevin (Deal Desk): To make this concrete — proposal idea: 12-month term, 750k tokens/mo commit, 12% unit discount off list, 30-day carryover, 90-day price protection. If they sign 36-month we can do 15% but require finance + legal approval and a minimum ARR threshold. Anyone object?

jordan (AE): Can you put numbers in a tiny table so I can present on the call? I need list price, discounted unit price, monthly ARR, and annualized.

anita (Sales Eng): Quick calc (draft):

```
Unit list price: $0.00400 per token
Discount: 12% -> unit price = $0.00352 per token
Monthly tokens: 750000
Monthly ARR = 750000 * $0.00352 = $2,640.00  <-- (note: tokens vs request counts, quick math)
Annualized = $2,640 * 12 = $31,680
```

kevin (Deal Desk): Hold up — looks like unit math mixup. We bill per 1k tokens typically or per 1M? Jordan, which unit are you using in the contract? Need to standardize to "per 1M tokens" or per-1000. If per-1M: recalc below.

anita (Sales Eng): Good catch. Recalc per 1M tokens:

```
List price: $4.00 per 1M tokens (equiv to $0.004 per 1k)
12% off -> $3.52 per 1M
Monthly tokens: 0.75M
Monthly ARR = 0.75 * $3.52 = $2.64k
Annual = $31.68k
```

kevin (Deal Desk): That's in line but still small — confirms pricing math. Approving provisional deal-desk terms: "12% discount, 30-day carryover, 90-day price protection" conditional on finance sign-off and legal DPA/SOW. I'll flag as deal-desk:approved-provisional and loop finance. :white_check_mark:

marc (Legal): I'll draft DPA + Dedicated addendum + SOW. If they ask for HSM or committed key custody we need to add enterprise add-on fees. Target: EOD drafts.

sam (CSM): I'll schedule the renewal demo/presentation for 9:00am PST tomorrow and include the price slide + perf numbers. Jordan — please confirm you can present the provisional numbers.

jordan (AE): Confirmed. I'll present the provisional terms and note legal/finance pending. @kevin @marc @anita please confirm final numbers by 8:00pm PT tonight so I can update the deck. Thanks everyone :pray:

kevin (Deal Desk): Will do. Looping finance now.

deploy-bot: Note: SOC2 link requires SSO access for external reviewers — we can provide a redacted PDF if they need it for procurement.

anita (Sales Eng): Perf runs queued — I'll post the 95/99 latency numbers and GPU utilization by 7pm PT.

marc (Legal): Drafts inbound.

sam (CSM): Adding the Talus exec invites.

jordan (AE): Great progress. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth.

kevin (Deal Desk): provisional approved, final pending finance/legal.

jordan (AE): Thanks all — tagging key owners again: @kevin (deal desk) / @marc (legal) / @anita (sales eng).
